rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 13 AND 30 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 545, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS AN ACT TO REGULATE THE PRACTICE OF ARCHITECTURE IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: States that ---     "A FOREIGNER ARCHITECT  OR PERSON   WHO IS  NOT AUTHORIZED PRACTICE ARCHITECTURE IN     THE PHILIPPINES BUT  SHALL STAY  IN   THE COUNTRY  FOR MORE THAN TWO (2)  MONTHS, IN CONNECTION WITH ANY BUILDING/STRUCT URE  /EDIFICE OR   LAND DEVELOPMENT PROJECT, SHALL BE DEEMED TO BE ENGAGED IN THE UNAUTHORIZED PRACTICE OF ARCHITECTURE. FOR THIS PURPOSE, THE BOARD  OF ARCHITECTS SHALL  ISSUE THE RULES  AND REGULATIONS TO ACHIEVE  THE OBJECTIVES OF THIS PROVISION." Penalizes the architect found violating this Act with imprisonment and a fine of not less than P200,000.00 to  not  more than   P5 Million, including perpetual disqualificatio n to  practise architecture.  * * *
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 1993-02-22
